question: Does decision-aware sensing improve acquisition of two-second inspection-goal dwell over fixed-range and uncertainty-triggered schedules in the same 4.2-second manoeuvre?
primary_comparisons: decision_aware minus fixed_range and uncertainty_triggered, separately in nominal and bounded_faults
primary_outcome: new goal acquisition with two-second dwell and full numerical containment; initially eligible cases are not acquisitions
physics: Basilisk 2.12.0 nonlinear point-mass orbital dynamics against analytical circular chief; no physical system
timing_scope: Clock completion times are frozen simulated inputs. Actual host durations are measured separately and do not establish physical deadline feasibility.
energy_scope: SA05 explicit model: 5 mJ initial decision plus 5 mJ realized checking, 0.001 mJ per counted planner/observer/checking operation, actual requested sensor 0.2/0.3 mJ and common warm sensor cost. Same 500 mJ envelope; offline arming and hardware power excluded. Failed work charged; no physical energy claim.
sampling: Independent discrete hash streams per split,stratum,unit,field; pair initial states and all exogenous conditions across policies. Noise is a latent error applied to each policy's actual simulated sensor geometry, not copied observed values.
tuning: No tuning of any method; same fixed command menu, nodes, work, sensing choices and initial information. Pilot selects only bounded sample size and execution budget.
missing_handling: Every scheduled cell has a result. Infrastructure failure, timeout and unstarted budget remainder stay explicitly missing, never physical impossibility. Paired primary inference is suppressed if either outcome is missing; report identification intervals.
stopping: One sequential attempt in declared order; no selective retries, replacement cases or sample extensions. Global limit marks remaining cells unstarted. Defect invalidation requires a new identity.
analysis: Exact paired conditional binary tests per stratum, four-comparison Holm adjustment; simultaneous conservative Hoeffding intervals for signed paired differences; exact binomial marginal intervals; costs and host times descriptive only.
acceptance: No operational noninferiority or flight-reliability criterion. A general benefit is not asserted from certificate counts or a null test. A valid negative/inconclusive result completes this stage.
replay: Same outcome and action categories; numerical potential tolerance 5e-5 m2; stored data identity exact; host durations not rerun as identity expectations.
ci_replay_sample: predeclared first two units per stratum and every method; full clean-environment replay performed locally
